sql-1757: SELECT product_id FROM Products WHERE low_fats='Y' AND recyclable='Y';
sql-584: SELECT name FROM Customer WHERE referee_id <> 2 OR referee_id IS NULL;
sql-595: SELECT name,population,area FROM World WHERE area>=3000000 OR population>=25000000;
sql-1148: SELECT DISTINCT author_id AS id FROM Views WHERE author_id=viewer_id ORDER BY id;
sql-1683: SELECT tweet_id FROM Tweets WHERE length(content)>15;
sql-1378: SELECT u.unique_id,e.name FROM Employees e LEFT JOIN EmployeeUNI u ON e.id=u.id;
sql-1068: SELECT p.product_name,s.year,s.price FROM Sales s JOIN Product p ON s.product_id=p.product_id;
sql-1581: SELECT v.customer_id,COUNT(*) AS count_no_trans FROM Visits v LEFT JOIN Transactions t ON v.visit_id=t.visit_id WHERE t.transaction_id IS NULL GROUP BY v.customer_id;
sql-197: SELECT w.id FROM Weather w JOIN Weather p ON p.recordDate=date(w.recordDate,'-1 day') WHERE w.temperature>p.temperature;
sql-1661: SELECT s.machine_id,ROUND(AVG(e.timestamp-s.timestamp),3) AS processing_time FROM Activity s JOIN Activity e ON s.machine_id=e.machine_id AND s.process_id=e.process_id AND e.activity_type='end' WHERE s.activity_type='start' GROUP BY s.machine_id;
sql-577: SELECT e.name,b.bonus FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Bonus b ON e.empId=b.empId WHERE b.bonus<1000 OR b.bonus IS NULL;
sql-1280: SELECT s.student_id,s.student_name,b.subject_name,COUNT(e.student_id) AS attended_exams FROM Students s CROSS JOIN Subjects b LEFT JOIN Examinations e ON e.student_id=s.student_id AND e.subject_name=b.subject_name GROUP BY s.student_id,s.student_name,b.subject_name ORDER BY s.student_id,b.subject_name;
sql-570: SELECT m.name FROM Employee m JOIN Employee e ON e.managerId=m.id GROUP BY m.id,m.name HAVING COUNT(*)>=5;
sql-1934: SELECT s.user_id,ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.action='confirmed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),2) AS confirmation_rate FROM Signups s LEFT JOIN Confirmations c ON s.user_id=c.user_id GROUP BY s.user_id;
sql-620: SELECT id,movie,description,rating FROM Cinema WHERE id%2=1 AND description<>'boring' ORDER BY rating DESC;
sql-1251: SELECT p.product_id,COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(p.price*u.units)*1.0/SUM(u.units),2),0) AS average_price FROM Prices p LEFT JOIN UnitsSold u ON p.product_id=u.product_id AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date GROUP BY p.product_id;
sql-1075: SELECT p.project_id,ROUND(AVG(e.experience_years),2) AS average_years FROM Project p JOIN Employee e ON p.employee_id=e.employee_id GROUP BY p.project_id;
sql-1633: SELECT contest_id,ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Users),2) AS percentage FROM Register GROUP BY contest_id ORDER BY percentage DESC,contest_id;
sql-1211: SELECT query_name,ROUND(AVG(rating*1.0/position),2) AS quality,ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rating<3 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END),2) AS poor_query_percentage FROM Queries GROUP BY query_name;
sql-1193: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',trans_date) AS month,country,COUNT(*) AS trans_count,SUM(CASE WHEN state='approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count,SUM(amount) AS trans_total_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN state='approved' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_total_amount FROM Transactions GROUP BY month,country;
sql-1174: WITH firsts AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(order_date) AS first_date FROM Delivery GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN d.order_date=d.customer_pref_delivery_date THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END),2) AS immediate_percentage FROM Delivery d JOIN firsts f ON d.customer_id=f.customer_id AND d.order_date=f.first_date;
sql-550: WITH firsts AS (SELECT player_id,MIN(event_date) AS first_date FROM Activity GROUP BY player_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Activity a WHERE a.player_id=f.player_id AND a.event_date=date(f.first_date,'+1 day')) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),2) AS fraction FROM firsts f;
sql-2356: SELECT teacher_id,COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS cnt FROM Teacher GROUP BY teacher_id;
sql-1141: SELECT activity_date AS day,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM Activity WHERE activity_date BETWEEN '2019-06-28' AND '2019-07-27' GROUP BY activity_date;
sql-1070: SELECT product_id,year AS first_year,quantity,price FROM Sales WHERE (product_id,year) IN (SELECT product_id,MIN(year) FROM Sales GROUP BY product_id);
sql-596: SELECT class FROM Courses GROUP BY class HAVING COUNT(*)>=5;
sql-1729: SELECT user_id,COUNT(*) AS followers_count FROM Followers GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id;
sql-619: SELECT MAX(num) AS num FROM (SELECT num FROM MyNumbers GROUP BY num HAVING COUNT(*)=1);
sql-1045: SELECT customer_id FROM Customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_key)=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Product);
sql-1731: SELECT m.employee_id,m.name,COUNT(*) AS reports_count,ROUND(AVG(e.age)) AS average_age FROM Employees m JOIN Employees e ON e.reports_to=m.employee_id GROUP BY m.employee_id,m.name ORDER BY m.employee_id;
sql-1789: SELECT employee_id,department_id FROM Employee WHERE primary_flag='Y' OR employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM Employee GROUP BY employee_id HAVING COUNT(*)=1);
sql-610: SELECT x,y,z,CASE WHEN x+y>z AND x+z>y AND y+z>x THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS triangle FROM Triangle;
sql-180: SELECT DISTINCT a.num AS ConsecutiveNums FROM Logs a JOIN Logs b ON b.id=a.id+1 AND b.num=a.num JOIN Logs c ON c.id=a.id+2 AND c.num=a.num;
sql-1164: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id,COALESCE((SELECT new_price FROM Products q WHERE q.product_id=p.product_id AND change_date<='2019-08-16' ORDER BY change_date DESC LIMIT 1),10) AS price FROM Products p;
sql-1204: WITH q AS (SELECT person_name,turn,SUM(weight) OVER(ORDER BY turn) AS total FROM Queue) SELECT person_name FROM q WHERE total<=1000 ORDER BY turn DESC LIMIT 1;
sql-1907: SELECT 'Low Salary' AS category,COUNT(*) AS accounts_count FROM Accounts WHERE income<20000 UNION ALL SELECT 'Average Salary',COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE income BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 UNION ALL SELECT 'High Salary',COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE income>50000;
sql-1978: SELECT employee_id FROM Employees e WHERE salary<30000 AND manager_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Employees m WHERE m.employee_id=e.manager_id) ORDER BY employee_id;
sql-626: SELECT CASE WHEN id%2=0 THEN id-1 WHEN id<(SELECT MAX(id) FROM Seat) THEN id+1 ELSE id END AS id,student FROM Seat ORDER BY id;
sql-1341: SELECT name AS results FROM (SELECT u.name FROM Users u JOIN MovieRating r ON u.user_id=r.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id,u.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,u.name LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT title FROM (SELECT m.title FROM Movies m JOIN MovieRating r ON m.movie_id=r.movie_id WHERE created_at>='2020-02-01' AND created_at<'2020-03-01' GROUP BY m.movie_id,m.title ORDER BY AVG(rating) DESC,m.title LIMIT 1);
sql-1321: WITH daily AS (SELECT visited_on,SUM(amount) AS total FROM Customer GROUP BY visited_on),w AS (SELECT visited_on,SUM(total) OVER(ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount,COUNT(*) OVER(ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS days FROM daily) SELECT visited_on,amount,ROUND(amount/7.0,2) AS average_amount FROM w WHERE days=7 ORDER BY visited_on;
sql-602: WITH friends AS (SELECT requester_id AS id FROM RequestAccepted UNION ALL SELECT accepter_id FROM RequestAccepted) SELECT id,COUNT(*) AS num FROM friends GROUP BY id ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 1;
sql-585: SELECT ROUND(SUM(tiv_2016),2) AS tiv_2016 FROM Insurance WHERE tiv_2015 IN (SELECT tiv_2015 FROM Insurance GROUP BY tiv_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (lat,lon) IN (SELECT lat,lon FROM Insurance GROUP BY lat,lon HAVING COUNT(*)=1);
sql-185: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY departmentId ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rk FROM Employee e) SELECT d.name AS Department,e.name AS Employee,e.salary AS Salary FROM ranked e JOIN Department d ON e.departmentId=d.id WHERE rk<=3;
sql-1667: SELECT user_id,upper(substr(name,1,1))||lower(substr(name,2)) AS name FROM Users ORDER BY user_id;
sql-1527: SELECT patient_id,patient_name,conditions FROM Patients WHERE conditions GLOB 'DIAB1*' OR conditions GLOB '* DIAB1*';
sql-196: DELETE FROM Person WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM Person GROUP BY email);
sql-176: SELECT MAX(salary) AS SecondHighestSalary FROM Employee WHERE salary<(SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee);
sql-1484: SELECT sell_date,COUNT(*) AS num_sold,group_concat(product,',') AS products FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sell_date,product FROM Activities ORDER BY sell_date,product) GROUP BY sell_date ORDER BY sell_date;
sql-1327: SELECT p.product_name,SUM(o.unit) AS unit FROM Products p JOIN Orders o ON p.product_id=o.product_id WHERE o.order_date>='2020-02-01' AND o.order_date<'2020-03-01' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name HAVING SUM(o.unit)>=100;
sql-1517: SELECT user_id,name,mail FROM Users WHERE mail GLOB '[A-Za-z]*@leetcode.com' AND substr(mail,1,length(mail)-13) NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]*';
